full_prompt_en: A square geometric illustration compresses an imaginary harbor town into a dense arrangement of interlocking rectangles, arches, wedges, and circles. The composition sits inside a narrow cream paper margin, with a pale dusty-blue field behind its colored blocks. At the lower edge, a dark blue boat-like shape rests beneath a wide yellow-red arch. Across the center, tall turquoise and ochre arches overlap black door-shaped openings, small stairs, and narrow vertical strips. A pointed tower rises at the left with a circular black opening, while layered red and blue blocks climb toward the upper right. Small stylized creatures or faces are tucked into the structure: a wide white pair of eyes looks out from a central dark rectangle, circular eyes recur in colored squares, and a little brown bird perches near the upper left. A yellow halo containing a single horizontal eye floats in the upper-left sky. Most shapes have precise flat edges, but surfaces include subtle striped and worn print textures. The palette is disciplined: turquoise blue, brick red, mustard yellow, black, gray-green, and warm ivory. There is little naturalistic perspective; depth comes from overlap, color blocking, and a few deep black voids. Light is graphic and even, with the yellow forms functioning as bright accents rather than realistic illumination. The vertical stack is busy but controlled, larger arches providing pauses among many small angular segments. The whole image feels playful and enigmatic, as if a compact city, harbor, and symbolic language have been folded into one patterned printed page.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形几何插画把一座想象港镇压缩为相互嵌合的长方形、拱形、楔形和圆形。构图放在窄窄的奶油纸边内，彩色块后是淡灰蓝底场。下缘，一条深蓝船形停在宽阔黄红拱门下。中部，高耸绿松石与赭色拱门重叠着黑色门洞、小台阶和窄竖条。左侧一座尖顶塔升起，带圆形黑洞，层叠红蓝色块则攀向右上。小小程式化生物或面孔藏在结构里：一对宽白眼睛从中央深暗长方形向外看，圆眼在彩色方块中重复，一只小棕鸟停在左上附近。左上天空悬着一轮黄光环，内部有一只横向眼睛。大多数形状边缘准确平整，表面却带轻微条纹和磨旧印刷肌理。调色严格：绿松石蓝、砖红、芥末黄、黑、灰绿与暖象牙色。画面几乎没有自然主义透视；纵深来自重叠、色块分割和少量深黑空洞。光是图形化而均匀的，黄色形体充当亮色点而非真实照明。竖向堆叠繁忙却受控，较大的拱形在众多细小尖角段落间提供停顿。整幅图既玩味又神秘，仿佛紧凑城镇、港口和象征语言被折叠进一张花纹印刷页。
style_prompt_en: Flat geometric illustration packs hard-edged rectangles, circles, triangles, and arches into a tightly interlocked composition. Turquoise, brick red, mustard yellow, gray-green, black, and warm cream recur in disciplined blocks rather than soft gradients. Small striped fills, fine wear, and subtle print grain prevent the precise shapes from looking sterile. Deep black apertures create pockets of depth amid mostly even graphic light. A narrow paper margin contains the busy arrangement, while a few large curved forms provide rests between finer angular fragments. Repeated circular marks and surprising small symbolic details make the pattern feel playful and enigmatic. The rhythm is vertical, dense, and carefully balanced by color area.
style_prompt_zh: 平面几何插画把硬边长方形、圆形、三角形和拱形紧紧嵌合成构图。绿松石、砖红、芥末黄、灰绿、黑与暖奶油在受控色块中重复，而非柔软渐层。细小条纹填色、轻微磨损和淡印刷颗粒让准确形状不显冰冷。深黑开口在近乎均匀的图形光中制造纵深口袋。窄纸边束住繁忙排列，几块大型弯形在细密尖角碎片间提供停顿。重复圆形痕迹和意外的小象征细节让图案玩味而神秘。节奏纵向、密集，并由色彩面积仔细平衡。
theme_en: An imaginary harbor town built from interlocking colored geometric blocks
theme_zh: 一座由彩色几何块相互嵌合而成的想象港镇
name: Valerio Adami
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
